question: 2025年中实付销售额高于该年月均销售额的月份有哪些？（请给出月份与销售额）
gold_sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM monthly_rev WHERE revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM monthly_rev) ORDER BY revenue DESC, month
